name: spatial-diagnosis-dashboards
description: 국토종합진단지수 표준화 민감도 대시보드(메인) + 인천 1인가구·세대구조 대시보드(legacy-incheon)

scripts.deploy: vite build && cp dist/index.html docs/index.html && touch docs/.nojekyll
scripts.deploy:incheon: npm run build:incheon && mkdir -p docs/incheon && cp legacy-incheon/dist/index.html docs/incheon/index.html

//: npm run deploy → docs/index.html (SSI, 메인) / npm run deploy:incheon → docs/incheon/index.html (인천, 보존)
